title: Hardware Intelligence & Latency Update
headline: Clearer driver evidence, more useful timing analysis, and lighter system diagnostics.
changes: Driver Intelligence fills the app content area with a smoother page handoff and a one-time motherboard light sweep on entry or rescan.
Latency Analyzer adds a software timing probe, more consistent counter samples, and clearer graphs; it does not claim to measure mouse-to-display latency.
System Intelligence no longer starts an expensive deep hardware scan just to check whether a profile is ready, reducing redundant startup work.
Removed predictive warning banners from Home and simplified diagnostic messaging around measured system state.
Cleaner results now better reflect verified cleanup actions and preserve safe cache-maintenance behavior.
